newsitem.title: USA: Eastern to acquire five waste companies.
newsitem.headline: Eastern to acquire five waste companies.

text.p: Eastern Environmental Services Inc said Thursday it has signed definitive agreements to acquire five Florida collection companies with annualized revenues of about $14 million.
Terms of the proposed transaction were not disclosed.
All five companies, said Eastern, are located in Broward and Dade counties, and provide commercial and residential collection services to the Miami and Fort Lauderdale areas.

Eastern reported it will consolidate Environmental Waste Systems Inc, Combined Waste Services Inc, Ameri Carting Inc, A-1 Carting Corp, and Environmental Waste Systems of Palm Beach Inc, into a single operating company.
The agreement is subject to final due diligence by Eastern and other standard conditions.
